name: Latticino

programming.details: The on-board ESP32-PICO-D4 programs the MachXO2 over SPI, with Arduino IDE libraries. Project appears dormant (last active ~2020) and open-source design files are not clearly published.

description: One of the smallest ESP32 boards (12.5 x 30 mm, DIL20) pairing an ESP32-PICO with a MachXO2-1200 FPGA as an IoT building block; demoed GPIO-expander and I2S sigma-delta audio gateware.
